5. Payments, Cancellations and Cooling Off

5.1 Billing. Spotify will charge the price of your Paid Subscription to your payment method at the start of each subscription period.

5.2 Cancellation. If you purchased a Paid Subscription from Spotify, you may cancel it at any time on your Account page. Your Paid Subscription will continue until the end of your then-current subscription period, and you will not receive a refund for any fees already paid.

If you purchased through a third party such as Apple, cancel through that third party.

5.3 Price Changes. Spotify may change the price of Paid Subscriptions and will tell you in advance.

6. User Guidelines

Respect Spotify, the owners of the content, and other users.
